import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import Job, find_deficient_cut, compile_plan, check_plan

def feasible(n, links, demands, env, p=1):
    return find_deficient_cut(Job(n, links, demands, p, env)) is None

def tighten(n, links, demands, env, p=1):
    """maximally tight: try to drop each link, then lower rates one by one"""
    env = dict(env)
    for l in sorted(env):
        trial = dict(env); del trial[l]
        if feasible(n, links, demands, trial, p):
            env = trial
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for l in sorted(env):
            trial = dict(env)
            trial[l] -= 1
            if trial[l] == 0:
                del trial[l]
            if feasible(n, links, demands, trial, p):
                env = trial
                changed = True
                break
    return env

rng = random.Random(5150)
tot=fail=slow=0
fails=[]
t0all=time.monotonic()
for trial in range(120):
    n = rng.randint(3, 8)
    used=set(); links=[]
    for _ in range(rng.randint(3, 16)):
        u=rng.randrange(n); v=rng.randrange(n)
        if u==v: continue
        k=(min(u,v),max(u,v))
        if k in used: continue
        used.add(k); links.append((u,v,10))
    k = rng.randint(2, min(n, 5))
    ps = sorted(rng.sample(range(n), k))
    demands={v: rng.randint(0,5) for v in ps}
    if sum(demands.values())==0: continue
    base={l: rng.randint(1,5) for l in range(len(links))}
    if not feasible(n, links, demands, base):
        base = tighten(n, links, demands, base) if False else {l: v*4 for l,v in base.items()}
        if not feasible(n, links, demands, base):
            continue
    env = tighten(n, links, demands, base)
    assert feasible(n, links, demands, env)
    tot+=1
    job = Job(n, links, demands, 1, env)
    t0=time.monotonic(); plan = compile_plan(job, budget=8); dt=time.monotonic()-t0
    if dt>2: slow+=1
    if plan is None or not check_plan(job, plan):
        fail+=1; fails.append((n,links,demands,env,round(dt,2)))
print('tight instances', tot, 'failures', fail, 'slow', slow, 'elapsed', round(time.monotonic()-t0all,1))
for f in fails[:8]: print(f)
PY
